pkgmetadata.longdescription:
corosync 3.1.10 — the version required by pxvirt's pve-cluster.
Gentoo's sys-cluster/corosync-3.1.0 is missing: - CVE-2026-35091 and CVE-2026-35092 (merged upstream in 3.1.10) - knet ping timer fix on reload (merged upstream in 3.1.10)
This overlay ebuild tracks upstream 3.1.10 with two additional service-file patches not yet submitted upstream: - PrivateTmp=yes for systemd security sandboxing - ConditionPathExists for corosync.conf (prevents spurious service failure on nodes not yet joined to a cluster)
All ABI-affecting APIs (cmap, cpg, quorum, corotypes) are identical to 3.1.0; pve-cluster links cleanly against this package.
